questions.prompt: What did Anna carry to help Mum?
questions.evidenceText: "Yes!" said James and Anna. James grabbed the list. Anna grabbed the bags. Off they went!

questions.prompt: Why did James put both bunches of grapes in the basket?
questions.evidenceText: James found the grapes. Red ones or green ones? He put both bunches in the basket — just to be safe.

questions.prompt: What did they have after lunch?
questions.evidenceText: At home, Mum made lunch. After, they had their cakes. Chips ate the paper bag. "CHIPS!" they said. But they were laughing too hard to be cross.
